about.title: About me
about.heading: I build digital products with a point of view.
about.p1: Hi, I'm Danylo — a software engineering student and full-stack developer based in Poland.
about.p2: I started with HTML and CSS, then found my craft in JavaScript, React and Next.js. Today I build complete products, from interface details to APIs and databases.
about.p3: I enjoy the hard parts: turning a vague idea into a sensible flow, keeping the architecture clean and making every interaction feel intentional.
about.p4: For me, programming is equal parts engineering and creativity — a way to keep learning while solving real problems.
about.nowDescription: A focused full-stack workspace for getting work and ideas out of your head.
